cause_quote: The new scanner used `const records = params.events.map(({ eventJson }): unknown => JSON.parse(eventJson));`, retaining every decoded event through the usage scan.
user_saw: Gateway memory usage rose during keyed usage refreshes for large incognito conversations.
summary: The incognito usage scanner now keeps only navigation and usage fields from each decoded event while preserving usage totals and the checkpoint hash.
reasoning: The actor-owned scanner retained the full decoded transcript from its first implementation in #169327. I checked that #170712 activated that scanner without changing the decode loop and that the retired worker also accumulated decoded incognito events, so there was no verified working baseline for full-transcript retention.
